testsuite.title: Laser Calibration & Testsuite
testsuite.helpDefault: Hover over an input field to see a detailed explanation of the parameter.
testsuite.helpStartHeight: The starting Z-height for the first line of the test in mm. Helps to determine the perfect focal point.
testsuite.helpEndHeight: The ending Z-height for the last line of the test in mm.
testsuite.helpStepsLines: The number of test lines drawn between start and end height.
testsuite.helpAutoZ: Enable if your laser has a motorized Z-axis controlled by the controller.
testsuite.helpLineLength: Length of each individual horizontal test line on the workpiece in mm.
testsuite.helpLineSpacing: The vertical distance between the individual focus test lines in mm.
testsuite.helpSpeed: The travel speed of the laser for the test in mm/min.
testsuite.helpPower: The constant laser intensity for all focus lines from 10% to 100%.
testsuite.helpMinInterval: The smallest line spacing when rastering in mm. Smaller values result in very dense engravings.
testsuite.helpMaxInterval: The largest line spacing when rastering in mm. Larger values make gaps visible.
testsuite.helpStepsBoxes: The number of test tiles drawn with different raster densities.
testsuite.helpBoxSize: Edge length of the square test tiles in mm.
testsuite.helpSpacing: The distance between the tiles on the workspace.
testsuite.helpColsPower: Number of test tiles on the horizontal axis (power settings).
testsuite.helpMinPower: Lowest tested laser power on the left side of the grid.
testsuite.helpMaxPower: Highest tested laser power on the right side of the grid.
testsuite.helpRowsSpeed: Number of test tiles on the vertical axis (speed settings).
testsuite.helpMinSpeed: Lowest speed at the bottom of the grid in mm/min.
testsuite.helpMaxSpeed: Highest speed at the top of the grid in mm/min.
testsuite.helpWidth: Width of the individual tiles in the grid in mm.
testsuite.helpHeight: Height of the individual tiles in the grid in mm.
testsuite.helpGridSpacing: Distance between the individual tiles in the grid in mm.
testsuite.helpInterval: The line spacing when filling (Engrave Line Interval) in mm (Recommended: 0.08mm).
testsuite.helpColsPasses: Number of columns on the horizontal axis (number of passes).
testsuite.helpMinPasses: Lowest number of passes on the left side of the grid.
testsuite.helpMaxPasses: Highest number of passes on the right side of the grid.
testsuite.helpCutWidth: Width of the individual cut tiles in the grid in mm.
testsuite.helpCutHeight: Height of the individual cut tiles in the grid in mm.
testsuite.helpCutSpacing: Distance between the cut tiles in the grid in mm.
testsuite.helpConstPower: Laser power for all cut tests in % (Recommended: 100%).
testsuite.sequenceDesc: For perfect, burn-mark-free laser results, best go through the tests step by step:
testsuite.focusDesc: Find the optimal mechanical height. A perfectly focused dot burns finer and cuts deeper.
testsuite.intervalDesc: Find the optimal line spacing (mm). Too dense burns wood; too wide leaves stripes.
testsuite.engraveDesc: Determine your grayscale/colors via power and speed in homogeneous raster mode.
testsuite.cutDesc: Determine the optimal passes at constant 100% power to cut your material cleanly.
testsuite.perfectFocusTitle: How do I recognize perfect focus?
testsuite.perfectFocusDesc: The perfect focus (Point A) is the absolute finest, thinnest, and darkest line. If the laser is too high or too low, the dot becomes wider and paler (Point B). Choose the Z-height that creates the sharpest line.
testsuite.executionDesc: After clicking, the finished test pattern will be loaded and positioned centrally on your workspace. You can run it directly.
testsuite.intervalExplanationTitle: How do I recognize the perfect interval?
